summary: Manual extraction for rakudai-kishi-main vol-04's two short bonus chapters. Both chapters are Kagami Kusakabe secret-follow profiles rather than main-plot battles. The Stella chapter follows Stella's ordinary day: dawn running with Ikki, normal classes, a lunch appetite larger than Ikki, Shizuku and Alice combined, afternoon training, and a private lovestruck moment with Ikki's shirt. The Shizuku chapter follows Shizuku's ordinary day: sleepy dorm morning, trusted class health-representative and healer duties, Japanese-set-meal lunch preferences and meat avoidance, obsessive posting in Ikki's fan thread, and repeated short-sword sparring with Alice despite being outmatched.
notes: Only character and event files were created per p1-scan instruction.
Volume 04 source here contains two short side-story chapters; no main tournament advancement, abilities, items, factions, locations, systems or knowledge files were added.
Ikki and Alice/Nagi are included because both profiles provide direct daily-routine or relationship evidence for them, even though the chapter focus is Stella and Shizuku.
